faq1.q: Do I need technical skills to set up?
faq1.a: No. The interface is intuitive — just add dishes, upload photos, and print the QR code. Anyone can do it.

faq2.a: The customer scans the QR code, selects items from the menu, and taps 'Order'. The order is automatically sent to your WhatsApp.

faq3.q: Can I try it for free?
faq3.a: Yes! When you sign up, you get 7 days of free trial with full access to all features.

faq4.a: Yes, the interface is available in Russian, English, Kyrgyz, and Turkish.

faq5.q: Can I use this for a store instead of a restaurant?
faq5.a: Absolutely! OimoQR supports restaurants, online stores, and hotels. Choose your business type when signing up.
